name: Hanging Toes To Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your core.
Raise your legs, keeping them as straight as you can, until your toes touch the bar.
Lower slowly under control without swinging.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: An advanced hanging core exercise where you lift your straight legs until your feet touch the bar.
